taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.source_trace: Open the resource model, tenant membership rule, object lookup, serializer and export/download consumer. Write down whether tenant membership, ownership, a share grant or a combination authorizes this action.
controls.controlled_verification: Create private document B with a unique inert marker as owner B. Actor A first reads its own document, then requests B using the same A session. If the direct endpoint denies, trace the export relationship: can an A-owned export job accept document B? Compare the owner/tenant of both the job and every referenced document, at enqueue and consumption. Observe the exported marker or durable write, not just job creation.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An accepted job whose worker later rejects B is not a demonstrated document disclosure. A shared document is a legitimate control only under the recorded grant. Endpoint denial and a successful authorized owner read must use the same build.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind every referenced object to the caller action policy before use, including nested and batched objects. For mixed-owner batches verify the documented atomic/reject/filter behavior and absence of forbidden content in exports, logs and job results.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
